card.name: Starts of names and section headings
card.fires_on: The first piece of a capitalized word that begins a name or a heading, such as Ker- in Kermit, Kerendia or keratitis, Ste- in Stein, or Drugs at the start of a section title after a number like 7.1. It also fires on 'fetal' after 'can cause'.

modes.label: Name starts
modes.description: The opening piece of a person's name or brand name, split from the rest of the word.
modes.example: defense attorney for abortion doctor<< Ker>>mit Gosnell, speaks

modes.label: Drug section headings
modes.description: The word Drugs or Drug opening a numbered interaction subsection title.

modes.label: Fetal harm phrase
modes.description: The word fetal after 'can cause' in embryo-fetal toxicity statements.
modes.example: XALKORI can cause<< fetal>> harm when administered to a pregnant woman.
